% A part's entry in the table of contents, in an article: the space above
% it from article's \l@part (\addvspace{2.25em plus 1pt}), and below it
% only the next entry's space. An entry added between two headings leaves
% the second right under the first, as in the PDF.
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\tableofcontents
\section{A section}
Some text.
\subsection{A subsection}
Some text.
\part{Beginnings}
\section{After the part}
Some text.
\part*{An unnumbered part}
\addcontentsline{toc}{part}{An unnumbered part}
\section{Another section}
Some text.
\section{A numbered section}
\addcontentsline{toc}{section}{An unnumbered section}
\section*{An unnumbered section}
Some text.
\end{document}
